description: On LK, read/write: set Connect to a missing file, RefreshLink, read Connect and try a recordset; then to the linked file itself (no table SRC), then to a valid file prefixed with an unknown option ';FOO=bar', then to the text 'garbage'; finally restore the original Connect and RefreshLink. Errors, Connect and the file bytes are read after each step.
retentionNote: Designed r-enc-link probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
